description:
Apply the 'Midnight' master slide design to specific sections of the presentation. 

Goal: 
1. Load the 'Midnight.otp' template (located on Desktop).
2. Apply the 'Midnight' master slide ONLY to the Title Slide (Slide 1) and the Section Header slides (Slide 3 and Slide 6).
3. Ensure the other content slides (2, 4, 5, 7) remain on the default white background.
4. Save the presentation to '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/Q3_Marketing_Review_Final.odp'.
